summary: Whatcom County lookout site on Damfino Ridge: an L-5 cab built in 1935, abandoned in 1968, and now gone. Reached on foot from the Mt. Baker Highway.

facts.status_note: Cab abandoned in 1968 and now gone; the sources describe no surviving structure
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest

access.note: Trailhead beside the Mt. Baker Highway is plowed; no closure described in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Drive past Glacier on the Mt. Baker Highway to the trailhead on the left, shortly after the Nooksack Falls signs; then follow the trail to the ridge

events.note: L-5 cab; the sources do not name a builder

evidence.supports: built 1935 as an L-5 cab; abandoned 1968; now gone
evidence.quote: Built in 1935, this L-5 cab was abandoned in 1968 and is now gone.

notes_for_editor: The shared WebSearch budget ran out before this tower's search, so the story rests only on the four cached pages listed. No Forest Service, NRHP, or newspaper-archive source was checked, and no staffing names were found. WillhiteWeb gives 5,712 ft (about 1,741 m) against the record's 1737.1 m; left unchanged. No photos added: licences not checked. The removal date is not given in any source, so no removal event is recorded.
